faq.question: Do you place purchase orders for us?
faq.answer: We track inventory signals and operational follow-through. Purchasing authority and supplier contracts stay with you unless a separate sourcing engagement is defined.

faq.question: Is this only FBA?
faq.answer: Most work focuses on FBA availability and inbound. Scope for other fulfillment models is confirmed during the audit.

faq.question: How does this connect to PPC?
faq.answer: When stock cannot support demand, we recommend pausing or reallocating spend so advertising efficiency is not destroyed by stockouts.

faq.question: Can inventory support run without full-service management?
faq.answer: Yes. It can be a focused workstream or included under full-service account management.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com.
